prompt:
We need a structured scheduling document for our Q3 cold-chain audit. Please read the briefing file at pharma_logistics/schedules/pending/q3_audit_briefing.json and produce a file called schedule_report.json with the three checkpoint entries described there.

Specifically:
- CP-1 needs a quality review deadline 2.5 months from now for our Frankfurt EU hub, with calendar anchoring and results shown in European/Berlin time.
- CP-2 needs the time conversion for a regulatory meeting fixed at 2026-09-15 at 10:00 AM Tokyo time, expressed in Chicago time for our US hub manager.
- CP-3 needs a dispatch window starting 45 minutes from now for the US Chicago hub, but our compliance team insists the current time must NOT be read from the server clock — it must come from a network time source.

Each checkpoint entry should include at minimum the fields listed in required_output_fields in the briefing, plus its id and description.
